info.description: A section displaying featured or latest blog posts on the storefront homepage.

adminDisplayTitle.description: Internal name to identify this blog section in Strapi admin lists.

title.description: Main title heading of the blog section (e.g. 'From Our Journal' or 'Latest Editorial').

badge.description: Top badge or label displayed above the section title (e.g. 'BLOG & NEWS').

description.description: Short subtitle or introductory text below the blog section title.

style.description: Layout style identifier for the blog cards grid (e.g. style-1, style-2).

headerStyle.description: Header title and badge typography style (e.g. style-1, style-2).

source.description: How blog posts are populated: 'latest' (most recently published), 'views' (most read), or 'manual' (pick specific posts).

postCount.description: Number of blog posts to display when source is 'latest' or 'views' (default: 3).

posts.description: Manually chosen blog posts (only used when source is set to 'manual').
